title: PaginationMeta
description: Pagination metadata included in list endpoint responses.

total.description: Total number of records matching the query (across all pages).

limit.description: Number of records returned per page.

totalPages.description: Total number of pages, derived from CEIL(total / limit).

hasNextPage.description: True if there is a subsequent page available.

hasPreviousPage.description: True if there is a preceding page available.
